note: Every run of the loop, as printed. dE76 in CIE Lab between the film's region medians and the game's; lower is closer, under ~2.3 is hard to see.

runs.what: first loop: every pixel of a class compared; light and colour corrected together
runs.verdict: diverged: shadows too bright, so it cut the sky light, everything darkened, materials pushed to white

runs.what: sun moved to the film's side; storm sprites given their own mask class; light separated from colour; damped
runs.verdict: sky, ground and far haze converge; wood, cliffs and spires do not

runs.what: sunlit faces compared with sunlit faces; spires get their own haze
runs.verdict: closes to 6.0; cliffs and wood hit a ceiling: brighter than white needed

runs.what: the film's opening framing: the open edge of town
runs.verdict: ground within 1, but most wood in view is now shaded

runs.what: far ring of mesas; wood measured on its brightest faces
runs.verdict: the loop turned the wood blue-green to satisfy one median: a number met, a look broken

runs.what: neutral boards, hue guard rail, near mesas at the film's scale
runs.verdict: kept: sky 0.7, haze 2.8, ground 0.0 / shadow 2.2, spire 6.5; cliffs 24.8 and wood 21.1 are the limit

runs.what: side light, to light Tex's back as the film does
runs.verdict: rejected: the wood worsened and Tex still read dark
